events.info: Kelly Love JonesREGGAEMERICANA vanguard Kelly Love Jones is a New Orleans singer-songwriter and pioneer of blending reggae, roots, world music, hip hop, and soul with uplifting songs that celebrate kindness, growth, and human connection. She has shared the stage with artists including Lenny Kravitz, Stephen Marley, Steel Pulse, Meshell Ndegeocello, and Arrested Development, and has written with Grammy-nominated spoken word artist Queen Sheba. Inspired by advice from Chaka Khan to "never give up," Jones continues to create music that is both soulful and empowering. This performance features: Kelly Love Jones - guitar, cajon, congas, and lead vocals Ruben Watts - congas Peter Boutte - congas,percussion, and vocals ZEE - piano Shows at 7:30pm & 9:30pm Doors at 7:00pm & 9:00pm Restaurant is Open 5pm - 10pm for dinner before or after your showtime: Advance Ticket Holders can now automatically make dinner table reservations for the Dining Room online via OpenTable.com ! Dinner Service without Advance Concert Tickets is first-come, first-served based on availability upon arrival. Full Bar is Open 5pm - Midnight for all, on show nights, with or without tickets. In order to preserve the integrity, quiet and focus of our world class intimate concerts, only the charcuterie, cocktails and soft drinks are available for table service inside the Music Room. However, we encourage you to arrive at least 90 Minutes prior to your showtime in order to enjoy full, relaxing dinner service in the Dining Room right next door, before getting seated in the Music Room for your ticketed showtime. Due to our intimate venue's limited seating capacity, advance tickets are strongly suggested in order to guarantee seats for this acclaimed show!

events.name: Brad Walker with Oscar Rossignoli
events.info: Brad Walker with Oscar Rossignoli*Happy Hour Concert Series* featuring Brad Walker with Oscar Rossignoli Join us for Happy Hour! Brad Walker is a New Orleans-based saxophonist and composer known for his expressive playing and genre-crossing approach to jazz. He has performed and recorded with artists including Bernard Purdie, Peter Erskine, George Porter Jr., Zigaboo Modeliste, Anders Osborne, Marcia Ball, Rickie Lee Jones, and Valerie June, while also touring and recording with Sturgill Simpson. Oscar Rossignoli is a Honduran-born pianist and composer who has been based in New Orleans since 2015. His music draws from classical music, Latin jazz, and North American jazz traditions. An in-demand collaborator, Rossignoli has performed with Jason Marsalis, John Boutté, Dee Dee Bridgewater, Herlin Riley, Joe Dyson, and Brad Walker, among many others. Walker and Rossignoli share a long-standing musical partnership, having collaborated on numerous projects and recordings, including Walker's Quintet and Live at Snug Harbor. Together, they bring a distinctive blend of modern jazz, improvisation, soulful melodies, and adventurous interplay to the stage. Doors: 4 pm Show: 5 - 6pm Snug Harbor Jazz Bistro presents free live weekly concerts. You can see these shows every Wednesday, Saturday and Sunday in person or by streaming on the Snug Harbor Facebook page. This is a free performance with no ticketing. Seating is on a first come-first served basis. Restaurant is Open 5pm - 10pm for dinner after showtime

events.name: Delfeayo Marsalis & the Uptown Jazz Orchestra: A Tribute to the Dirty Old Man
events.info: Delfeayo Marsalis & the Uptown Jazz OrchestraDelfeayo Marsalis & the Uptown Jazz Orchestra: A Birthday Tribute to Roger , "rdquo" -> The Dirty Old Man" Lewis Celebrate the birthday of legendary New Orleans baritone saxophonist Roger , "rdquo" -> The Dirty Old Man" Lewis with Delfeayo Marsalis & the Uptown Jazz Orchestra! Led by Grammy-winning trombonist, composer, producer, and NEA Jazz Master Delfeayo Marsalis, the Uptown Jazz Orchestra is a powerhouse big band dedicated to keeping the rich traditions of New Orleans and American jazz alive while putting its own unmistakable spin on the music. Founded in 2007, the orchestra brings together a dynamic ensemble of trumpets, trombones, saxophones, rhythm section, and vocalists, combining classic big-band swing with New Orleans brass-band energy, funk, blues, R&B, and spontaneous collective improvisation. At the heart of the UJO sound is a deep connection to the New Orleans tradition---drawing inspiration from the swinging riff bands of Count Basie, the sophisticated arrangements of Duke Ellington, the adventurous spirit of Charles Mingus, and the dance-driven energy of the Dirty Dozen Brass Band. This special performance honors Roger Lewis, a founding member of the Uptown Jazz Orchestra and one of New Orleans' most distinctive baritone saxophonists. Expect a high-energy evening of swinging jazz, funk, brass-band grooves, and musical surprises as the UJO celebrates Roger's remarkable career, contributions to New Orleans music, and birthday. Come celebrate Roger Lewis with the Uptown Jazz Orchestra and experience the joyous, unmistakable sound of New Orleans' premier big band! events.name: Vincent Neil Emerson, Hayden Redwine
events.info: Vincent Neil Emerson Since his 2019 debut, Emerson has made his contemporary mark on the tradition of American songwriting. His newest and fourth full-length album, Blue Stars, with longtime label La Honda Records, visits all of the influences and moods of his previous releases. Blue Stars features 13 original songs and is a testament to his songwriting prowess. Having dabbled across country, folk, and Americana music with his first three records, Emerson brings all three of those genres together with his latest release. Lyrically, these songs are rooted in his upbringing in East Texas, life on the road, and his deep family ties to Louisiana---three landscapes that continue to shape his perspective and inform his writing. , "rdquo" -> I was definitely thinking a lot about my childhood in Texas and the trips to Louisiana to visit my mother's family there. A lot of the music I love comes from those areas, and I think it's important to have a sense of pride in where you come from." But sonically, Blue Stars reaches wider. It brings together the hard country sound of his early work, the stripped-down intimacy of his self-titled record, and the bold rock 'n' roll of The Golden Crystal Kingdom. The result is a record that offers something for every listener who has followed his journey---while also serving as a perfect entry point for those just discovering his music. Hayden Redwine will open the show.

events.name: Oscar Rossignoli Quartet
events.info: Oscar Rossignoli QuartetHonduran-born pianist Oscar Rossignoli folds many traditions into his music, from his classical music formation to his passion for Latin and North American jazz. He's currently based in New Orleans and works with some of the city's best jazz musicians, including John Boutté, Jason Marsalis, Gladney, Amina Scott, Yusa and more. He has also established his reputation in various bands, including the EXTENDED trio with Matt Booth and Brad Webb, and by leading his own quartet and trio. Oscar earned a Master's degree at the University of New Orleans, where he was named the 2015--2016 ASCAP Louis Armstrong Scholar and was a finalist in the 2018 Ellis Marsalis International Jazz Piano Competition. This performance features: Oscar Rossignoli - piano Shows at 7:30pm & 9:30pm Doors at 7:00pm & 9:00pm Restaurant is Open 5pm - 10pm for dinner before or after your showtime: Advance Ticket Holders can now automatically make dinner table reservations for the Dining Room online via OpenTable.com ! Advance Ticket-Holders can also make table reservations for dinner in the Restaurant next door by Emailing reservations@snugjazz.com after your tickets have been purchased online for the Music Room. Dinner Service without Advance Concert Tickets is first-come, first-served based on availability upon arrival. Bar Room is Open 5pm - Midnight, with or without tickets. Kind Reminder: Snug Harbor does NOT serve the full menu inside the Music Room. We do offer cheese and charcuterie tray options. In order to preserve the integrity, quiet and focus of our world class intimate concerts, only the charcuterie, cocktails and soft drinks are available for table service inside the Music Room. However, we encourage you to arrive at least 90 Minutes prior to your showtime in order to enjoy full, relaxing dinner service in the Dining Room right next door, before getting seated in the Music Room for your ticketed showtime.
